title: Combine history pages
responsibility: Combines loaded history pages while keeping the first occurrence of each event.

inputs.name: historyPages.pages
inputs.description: Each argument is one page of an entity's history events, in the order the pages were read; any number of pages may be passed, and with none the value is an empty array. Matching uses only `id`: a later event is dropped when an earlier page or an earlier position in the same page already holds its `id`, whatever its other fields contain.

outputs.name: historyPages
outputs.description: The events of every page in argument order, with each later event whose `id` already appeared removed, so the copy from the earliest page is the one returned; the returned events are the same objects that were passed in. It is never sorted by `at`, so the order follows the pages even where timestamps disagree.
